node.label: sialidosis type 1
node.definition: Sialidosis type 1 (ST-1) is a very rare lysosomal storage disease, and is the normosomatic form of sialidosis, characterized by gait abnormalities, progressive visual loss, bilateral macular cherry red spots and myoclonic epilepsy and ataxia, that usually presents in the second to third decade of life.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
